name: Uda Devi Pasi
role: Dalit woman fighter in the Lucknow theatre
contribution: Uda Devi Pasi is associated with the armed resistance in the Lucknow theatre of the 1857 rebellion.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: Her memory broadens accounts of 1857 by foregrounding the participation of Dalit women fighters in the Lucknow resistance.
highlight: Uda Devi Pasi is remembered as a Dalit woman fighter associated with the Lucknow theatre of 1857.
seoTitle: Uda Devi Pasi: A Woman Fighter in the 1857 Rebellion
seoDescription: Learn about Uda Devi Pasi and the memory of Dalit women's participation in the Lucknow resistance of 1857.
shortAnswer: Uda Devi Pasi was a Dalit woman fighter associated with armed resistance in Lucknow during the 1857 rebellion.
